input_pattern: solved Sudoku rows: (row*3 + row/3 + column + batch_index%2)%9+1; token 10 between rows
snapshots: retain every cumulative latent; fixed decode uses out-of-place sums, avoiding the upstream aliasing helper
pipeline_scope: host input IDs -> GPU outputs and independent snapshots -> host code/output IDs; logits/snapshots retained on GPU; destruction excluded
resident_scope: resident BLC latent -> decoder middle block BLC output; no input/output host copies
timing: synchronized wall clock and CUDA stream event span, including host-submission gaps; not summed kernel time
instrumented_stages: separate reconstruction pass: embedding/pre-quant after input upload; each encode level from residual/downsample through Phi contribution (excluding accumulation, residual subtraction and unused reference z_levels); full decoder logits; output argmax. Instrumentation perturbs dispatch; not additive headline timings.
